Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_buffer VARCHAR2(9);
Begin
 temp_buffer := :s_contract_id;
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 select company into :s_company from contracts
 where contract_id = temp_buffer
 and contract_type='RG'
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 /* Modified by HCL CONSULTING */
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);
NEXT_ITEM;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 begin
 select contract_id, company into
 :s_contract_id, :s_company
 from contracts
 where upper(company) like
 ('%'||temp_buffer || '%')
 and sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1)
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 /* Modified by HCL CONSULTING */
 and contract_type = 'RG' ;
 exception
 when too_many_rows then
 :s_contract_id := temp_buffer;
 :s_company := null;
 list_values;
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('5150');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 when too_many_rows then
 :s_contract_id := temp_buffer;
 :s_company := null;
 list_values;
 when others then handle_error; check_package_failure;
 end;

Item.Name: BATCH_ID
Item.Hint: Enter value for batch ID or use [LISTVAL].

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_min_temp number(5,2);
 temp_count number;
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 begin
 select b.min_temp, b.max_temp
 into temp_min_temp, :max_temp
 from batch_inputs b
 where b.batch_id = :batch_id and
 substr(b.batch_id,8,2) = 'CB' and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 exists (select 'x'
 from units
 where batch_id = b.batch_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and nvl(qc_checkin_flag,'*') != 'Y'
 and (red_tube_flag is null
 or purple_tube_flag is null or
 serum_plasma_ind is null or red_tube2 is null));
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error('1130');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select count(*),
 count(decode(red_tube_flag, null,1,
 decode(purple_tube_flag, null, 1,
 decode(serum_plasma_ind, null,1,
 decode(red_tube2,null,1,null)))))
 into :s_unit_count, :s_count_no_trns
 from units
 where batch_id = :batch_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 nvl(qc_checkin_flag,'*') != 'Y' ;
 if :s_unit_count = 0
 then
 show_error('0085');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;

end;

Item.Name: RED_TUBE_FLAG
Item.Hint: Enter Reason for Tube Missing, use [LISTVAL].

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if :old_tube_flag = 'Y' and nvl(:red_tube_flag,'*') != 'Y' then
 show_error('2512') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 end if ;
 if :red_tube_flag is not null then
 if :red_tube_flag in ('Y') then
 begin
 select 'x' into :GLOBAL.x from units where unit_id=:unit_id
 and received_date=:received_date
 and chapter_id=:chapter_id and
 nvl(red_tube_flag,'N')='Y';
 exception when no_data_found then
 show_error('1081');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 else
 begin
 select 'x' into :Global.x from master_codes where
 code_type='MISST' and code=:red_tube_flag and
 sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);
 exception when no_data_found then
 show_error('1081');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 end if;
end;
